A fairly cold last half of January meant that I was invited to the building at Princess Alexandra Square. The exchange of cold air had not only allowed me to observe the various sculptures which are in this space, but had also given me the opportunity to have a talk with the composer and sculptor Lucianne Tursi.
Her research work with the materials and their characteristics was not restricted to the use of bronze but included a wide range of materials ranging from clay and paper, creating a commission from Kathy White at Whitebridge House.
She is curious about unusual shapes, she talks about the experiments
